Fullburst.Description: The trigger is broken and can get stuck, causing almost the entire magazine to unload with a single pull—or not, as it might jam in the meantime. Fullburst, but only sometimes
Fullburst.Explanation: Weapon variant with a 30-round burst fire mode only, featuring reduced fire rate and recoil, but with an increased chance of jamming due to higher heat buildup

Experimental.Description: They did everything to this weapon: touch it in forbidden places, pull the trigger with thumb, put vaseline in the barrel and paint it pink. Nightmare fuel!
Experimental.Explanation: Weapon variant with increased malfunction chanse but no misfire malfunction, increased durability burn, but with increased fire rate and no recoil. Features only full auto fire mode

Slav \"Thing\".Description: If it works, don't question it. If it doesn't work, hit it with a wrench. Classic Slav engineering
Slav \"Thing\".Explanation: Weapon variant chambered in 7.62x39mm with increased stabilization point, increased recoil, dispersion and decreased ergonomics

Freedom \"Thing\".Description: If it works, don't question it. If it doesn't work, shoot it until it does. Classic American engineering
Freedom \"Thing\".Explanation: Weapon variant chambered in 5.56x45mm NATO with decreased recoil, increased ergonomics and fire rate but with increased stabilization point

Lawn Mower.Description: BRRRRRRRRRRRR - the grass is gone. The enemy is gone. Your hearing is gone
Lawn Mower.Explanation: A weapon variant with almost tripled fire rate, decreased recoil and no heat buildup, but with bad dispersion and bullet velocity

Pistol.Description: A weapon variant designed specifically for pistol quests, tailored for those who dislike using actual pistols
Pistol.Explanation: Bolt-action rifles with significantly improved accuracy and handling, but chambered in the 9x18mm pistol caliber

BFG-50.Description:
"The BFG-50 was Mark Serbu's first rifle design, coming into production in late 1999. It is on the civilian market for a price of $2,000-$3,000 USD, but is not intended to be used by any armed forces in the world"
~https://guns.fandom.com/wiki/Serbu_BFG-50
BFG-50.Explanation: Weapon variant chambered in .50 BMG with significantly increased recoil, slightly increased ergonomics and with only a 1-round magazine

Laser Rifle.Description:
"That is the third time I am trying to make a Laser Rifle. Third time's a charm?"
*Clicking*
"It's not... oh, it was not on! Maybe now?"
*Small explosion*
"Oh, ffs!"
Laser Rifle.Explanation: Weapon variant chambered in 9x21mm caliber ammo, shooting 3-bullet burst with incredible fire rate and increased muzzle velocity

Converted.Description: We have successfully converted your weak-ass shotguns and pistols to the medium-ass assault rifles, or something, I don't care...
Converted.Explanation: Weapon variant chambered in 9x39mm caliber with increased durability burn
